why: The code shows one correct aspect of the concept: the loop body re-reads a value with StdIn.readInt() each iteration and the condition tests the sentinel 0, so the student has a working model of how a loop gets each new number. But it is not correct new code (x is declared inside the body so the while condition references an out-of-scope variable and won't compile; it also prints the 0), and no explanation is given, so it cannot be L2 or L4; it is not L0 because the loop-input idea itself is not misread with everyday meanings.
